summary: DNA X, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a securities purchase agreement with DNA Holdings Venture, Inc., a related party, for the private placement of 1,346,531 shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock at $6.00 per share, totaling $8.1 million ($5.0M cash plus cancellation of $3.1M note). Proceeds are for working capital. The preferred stock automatically converts to common after stockholder approval. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation like a tender offer or going-private transaction.
